name: A Level Physics: Quantwick
subtitle: Labs, fields, quantum and more
shortDescription: Adaptive A Level physics revision with a virtual apparatus bench, required practicals, board papers and real-world builds. No account.
longDescription:
A Level Physics: Quantwick is an adaptive A Level and AS physics course in a spectroscopy-lab style. Learn each topic in specification order, or switch to Real-World and learn by building things.

### Study Your Way
- Syllabus view in specification order (AS or full A Level) and a Real-World view with guided builds
- Adaptive quizzes: wrong answers lead to the right lesson, strong answers move you on
- Unit tests, cumulative tests and board-style mock papers with a report and study plan

### The Apparatus Bench
- Predict, set up, take readings, plot, fit a line with uncertainty, and evaluate
- Virtual required practicals and labs: SHM, waves, fields, capacitors, gases, radioactivity, quantum
- Equation and units practice for numeric answers

### Built for the Specifications
- Topics tracked point by point against the DfE content and the AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR (A and B) and Eduqas specifications
- Coverage screen with per-point progress and sources
- Optional "Other boards" view: see where each topic sits in GCSE, A Level, IB and AP

### Easy to Read
- Text size A-/A+ from 50% to 300%, works offline, no account
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
